description: Safecall hooks. On session start, say the real date and time of this computer and where we stopped last time. Before writing to a file that already exists, make the copy that makes the change undoable - a new file is never blocked, reading is never blocked, and the only refusal is a file that could not be copied at all. Every hook goes through hooks/python.sh (step 0 guard): it runs only with a real Python 3 and otherwise does nothing - on a Mac without Apple's Command Line Tools it never runs the /usr/bin/python3 stub that pops Apple's install window, and on Windows it finds python.org's `python` or `py` and never starts the Microsoft Store stub. With no Python the session start says so in one line, and the session goes on without safecall.
